name: external-api
description: Third-party API documentation delayed. Blocking implementation. Need to assess workarounds or escalation.
expected_behavior: Present options: mock API, early access request, alternative provider, scope reduction. Reference timeline impact.
scenarios: Project deadline is at risk if blocker slips further
success_indicators: Blocker is clearly stated (Stripe API docs, 2-week delay)
Timeline risk is highlighted (Q1 deadline jeopardy)
Options include: mock API, early access, alternative, scope reduction
Trade-offs are surfaced (mock API cost, alternative provider cost, scope reduction impact)
No commitment to timeline without addressing blocker
